title: macOS: Automatically handle rpaths in our app bundle
description:
Instead of skipping over libraries prefixed with @rpath and handling
them manually, scan our executables for valid prefixes and use those to
discover library paths.

Modernize our code in other places.

@geraldcombs Looks like this MR is causing issues with recent DMG files available from macOS Intel Automated downloads.

On a bare metal macOS Monterey, Version 12.6.7 (21G651) I installed recent automated build "Wireshark 4.1.0rc0-2999-gb494a22780df Intel 64.dmg".

Launching Wireshark from CLI triggered a crash with the following CLI messages:

```
dyld[20670]: Library not loaded: '@rpath/libsnappy.1.dylib'
  Referenced from: '/Applications/Wireshark.app/Contents/Frameworks/libwireshark.0.dylib'
  Reason: tried: '/Applications/Wireshark.app/Contents/MacOS/../Frameworks/libsnappy.1.dylib' (no such file), '/Applications/Wireshark.app/Contents/MacOS/../Frameworks/libsnappy.1.dylib' (no such file), '/Applications/Wireshark.app/Contents/MacOS/../Frameworks/libsnappy.1.dylib' (no such file), '/usr/lib/libsnappy.1.dylib' (no such file)Library not loaded: '@rpath/libpcre2-8.0.dylib'
  Referenced from: '/Applications/Wireshark.app/Contents/Frameworks/libwsutil.0.dylib'
  Reason: tried: '/Applications/Wireshark.app/Contents/MacOS/../Frameworks/libpcre2-8.0.dylib' (no such file), '/Applications/Wireshark.app/Contents/MacOS/../Frameworks/libpcre2-8.0.dylib' (no such file), '/usr/lib/libpcre2-8.0.dylib' (no such file)
zsh: abort      wireshark
```

Any recent automated DMG files and any DMG files built locally and installed from this MR forward trigger similar messages for Wireshark, tshark, etc.

No issue is seen with any locally built version with this MR applied if the applications are simply run from build folder.

With a DMG built from latest master after reverting 696b19dcdf1709dfc50269877746f332bc0a62cb resolves the issue reported above.
Thanks for catching this. Fix inbound in !11243.
